description: Save one durable style preference to the org's learned taste, with its source (the job, checkpoint or chat, plus the date). Only for a preference the user stated: a revise comment, a chat correction or an explicit "remember this"; never one-off brief content, footage facts or secrets. Tell the user what you saved and that they can say undo (forget_taste). Saving text the org already holds changes nothing. Refused, never truncated, past 2,048 bytes per entry or 4,000 characters per org, or while the owner has learned taste off; a refusal is final. get_profile returns the saved entries as `taste`.

body.description: Remember a style preference for the org. Saving text the org already holds changes nothing.

source.description: Where it came from: the job, checkpoint or chat, plus a date.

text.description: One durable style preference, at most 2048 bytes. An org's entries together hold at most 4000 characters.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: remember_taste

created.description: False when the org already held this exact text.

entry.description: One learned style preference: advice for agents, never enforcement.

title: Remember Taste
